sentences.japanese: 私はなぜか夜の方が元気だ。
sentences.english: For some reason I feel more alive at night.

sentences.japanese: 毎日朝と夜、猫に餌を与えています。
sentences.english: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.

sentences.japanese: 昨日の夜は出かけたの？
sentences.english: Did you go out last night?

sentences.japanese: 熊はまた、２４時間明るい夏は当てはまらないが、夜よりも昼に寝る傾向がある。夜活動するのはアザラシの行動と関係があるだろう。
sentences.english: Bears also tend to sleep more during the day than at night, although in the summer, with twenty-four hours of light, this does not apply.

sentences.japanese: 金曜日の夜、３人の男性がホワイト氏のホテルへやって来て、泊めてほしいと頼んだのです。
sentences.english: On Friday night, three men came into Mr White's hotel and asked for rooms.
